A circular pattern (Adjust) of a boss and a hole through all in it (mitcad#2380, from GitHub #577's design): the hole's copy is rebuilt at each copy and reaches past the bodies as the pattern has made them so far, so through that copy of the boss. Before, it measured the bodies before the pattern, which end short of the copy in its direction, and the pattern failed with 'element 1: there are no bodies in the extrude direction'.
A disk of 40 mm diameter, z -5..5 (Sketch1 F1, Extrude1 F2).
A boss x 15..35, y -5..5, z -5..5 joined to it (Sketch2 F3, Extrude2 F4): 2000 mm3 less the part inside the disk.
A hole of 4 mm from the plane x = 30 (Plane1 F5, Sketch3 F6) through all along +x (Extrude3 F7): through the boss's last 5 mm only, 20 pi mm3.

Both patterned four times about z (CircularPattern1 F8, Adjust): at element 1 the hole's copy starts at y = 30 and goes along +y, where the disk ends at y = 20 and only the boss's copy reaches y = 35. Every copy holed: 12566.37 + 4 (1521.03 - 62.83) mm3.
Identical moves the hole's tool as the original built it: the same.
